title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ServerFlavor
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ServerFlavor. Description of the available hardware configuration, such as processor, ram and disk capacities, of a physical or virtual server that can be launched. Subclass of InstantiationRequirement per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InstantiationRequirement model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServerFlavor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

cpu.description: Relationship. Capabilities of the virtual CPUs available in the flavor. Links to a CpuCapabilities entity.

memory.description: Relationship. Defines how much memory the given flavor provides. Links to a MemoryCapabilities entity.

gpu.description: Relationship. GPU capabilities of the flavor. Links to a GPU entity.

network.description: Property. Network capabilities of the flavor.

bootVolume.description: Relationship. Boot volume capabilities of the flavor. Links to a Disk entity.

additionalVolume.description: Relationship. Additional volume capabilities of the flavor. Links to one or more Disk entities.

confidentialComputing.description: Relationship. Details with respect to confidential computing capabilities of the flavor. Links to a ConfidentialComputing entity.

hypervisor.description: Relationship. Hypervisor as Gaia-X software resource. Links to a Hypervisor entity.

hardwareAssistedVirtualization.description: Property. Hardware-assisted virtualization enables full virtualization of unmodified guest operating systems in complete isolation by emulating complete hardware environments.

hwRngTypeOfFlavor.description: Property. Type of physical phenomena the hardware random number generator (RNG) of this flavor is based on. Controlled-vocabulary value (RNGTypes), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
